nodes.title: SG-8.3.2 context.md stack and module paths unit tests pass
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts reads the repo-root context.md. It requires the stack terms and only existing module paths, and it forbids the stale README-only text. The checks live in game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts. Desired behaviour: the checks stay strict and well defined, and the repo-root context.md satisfies them. Expected result: the unit tests pass. Why: SG-8.3 needs a context.md that matches the real stack and layout. Devion writes context.md from these tickets, so no Act or Verify unit edits it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when the stack check runs, then no term of STACK_TERMS (including TypeScript) is missing.
- Given the module table, when each path is checked against the repo root, then game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ exist and none is missing.
- Given the context.md text, when the stale-text check runs, then the README-only greeting and the traceability index are absent.


## Scope
- In scope: docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts helpers
- In scope: contextDoc and docsCheck unit tests
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code
- Out of scope: new product features
- Out of scope: writing context.md or .ai-dlc files from Act/Verify units
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin and its guard test
- Preserve: game/src never imports game/frontend
- Preserve: No source file over 200 lines
- Preserve: No test deleted or skipped


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- contextDoc and docsCheck unit tests pass in game/frontend
- npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · The Stack check requires TypeScript and every real stack term
nodes.body:
Context: STACK_TERMS in docsCheck.ts lists 'Phaser 3.90', 'React', 'Zustand', 'Radix' and 'Vitest'. Its doc comment says the Stack section also names TypeScript, but the term is not enforced. Desired behaviour: the term list includes TypeScript, so a context.md without it fails. Expected result: missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) is empty only for a context.md naming the full stack. Why: the stack check then matches the done-when condition.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given STACK_TERMS, when it is read, then it contains 'TypeScript' alongside the five existing terms.
- Given a text lacking 'TypeScript', when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then the result contains 'TypeScript'.
- Given a text naming every term in any letter case, when missingTerms runs, then the result is [].


## Scope
- In scope: STACK_TERMS in game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts
- Out of scope: context.md content
- Out of scope: backend changes
- Preserve: missingTerms case-insensitive behaviour
- Preserve: existing term order


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 (no Phaser 4 migration)
- File stays under 200 lines
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- STACK_TERMS includes TypeScript
- docsCheck tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Stale README-only text is detected and module paths are checked against disk
nodes.body:
Context: contextDoc.test.ts matches the stale phrases ('hello Worldseed', 'Traceability index', the UNKNOWN entry-point row) with inline regexes. No exported helper does this. contextModulePaths already extracts game/ and backend/ table paths, and missingPaths checks them against disk. Desired behaviour: docsCheck.ts exports a staleTextHits(md) helper that returns the stale phrases it finds, so the test uses it instead of inline regexes. Expected result: a context.md with stale text yields hits, and a rewritten one yields []. Why: the check becomes reusable and states the contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given text containing 'hello Worldseed', when staleTextHits runs, then it returns a list containing that phrase.
- Given text containing neither stale phrase nor the UNKNOWN entry-point row, when staleTextHits runs, then it returns [].
- Given a table with game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, when contextModulePaths then missingPaths run with an exists stub returning true, then the result is [].


## Scope
- In scope: staleTextHits in game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts
- In scope: module-path contract comment in contextDoc.ts
- Out of scope: editing context.md
- Out of scope: GDD content
- Preserve: contextModulePaths first-seen order and de-duplication
- Preserve: missingPaths and indexedPaths behaviour


## Technical constraints
- Every step lands green in game/ and game/frontend/
- Files under 200 lines
- game/src never imports game/frontend
- No test deleted or skipped


## Definition of done
- staleTextHits is exported and used by the context test
- contextDoc tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
